newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Discovery Zone Inc sells $85 mln in units.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Discovery Zone Inc sells $85 mln in units.

text.p: The following 144a issue of units including debt and warrants from Discovery Zone Inc was priced on Tuesday via lead manager Jefferies & Co Inc, according to market sources.
Discovery Zone, based in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., operates 208 indoor play centers around the country.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to finance the company's emergence from bankruptcy.
